summary: Iteration 30 (Personnel-Brief 10-section spec PDF + Annual Tax Donation Letter PDF + Assignment-History admin UI) fully validated. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass (test_iteration30_brief_tax_assignments.py) and the combined regression suite (iter25+iter27+iter28+iter29+iter30 = 85 tests) passes green in ~33s. (A) GET /api/me/personnel-brief/pdf returns Content-Type application/pdf, %PDF magic, and pypdf-extracted text contains ALL 10 section headers ('Personal Information', 'Organization Information', 'Civilian Education', 'Languages', 'Financial Obligations', 'Donations', 'Community Service', 'Awards', 'Events Attended', 'Assignment History'). After admin PUT /api/members/{id} with 2 assignment_history rows (Texas/Senior Sirius/Houston/Treasurer is_current=true + Theta-3/Junior Sirius finished), regenerated PDF embeds 'Senior Sirius' AND 'Treasurer' text in §10. (B) GET /api/me/tax-letter/pdf?year=2025 returns >5KB application/pdf containing 'EIN', '82-0794957', 'Cory T. Burnett', 'Co-Founder', 'Alpha Omega Phi'. Embedded signature image verified by walking page Resources/XObject (>=1 /Subtype /Image found). Default year (no param) defaults to last completed year (filename suffix matches now.year-1). With injected 2025 transactions (1 completed dues $105 + 1 completed donation $25 + 1 pending dues $999 to exclude), the PDF total line is exactly $130.00, $999 does NOT appear, both $105.00 and $25.00 appear, and the marker description shows up exactly 2 times (pending excluded). Cleanup deletes injected docs. (C) Admin can write all 8 ranks (Grand Sirius / Master Sirius / Senior Sirius / Advanced Sirius / Junior Sirius / Eagle / Clover / Guardian) via PUT /api/members/{id}.assignment_history; round-trip via GET /api/auth/me preserves every rank + is_current flag. Regression smokes pass: /me/personnel-brief (JSON), /payments/zeffy/validate, /events, /admin/members/bulk-import/template. Frontend: Verified via Playwright — (1) /profile (member@clubhaven.app) shows TWO header buttons: data-testid='download-my-brief-btn' AND the tax-letter block (data-testid='tax-letter-block', 'tax-letter-year-select', 'download-tax-letter-btn'). Year picker exposes 6 options [2026, 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021] = current + 5 prior. Clicking the tax-letter button triggers a real PDF download (aop-tax-letter-2025.pdf) and the toast 'Tax letter for 2025 downloaded' appears. (2) /admin → Members → Edit a member: data-testid='assignment-history-editor' is rendered at the bottom of the dialog with 'Add row' (data-testid='add-assignment-btn'). Adding a row exposes assignment-row-0 with ALL expected inputs: assignment-start-0, assignment-end-0, assignment-current-0, assignment-chapter-0, assignment-chapter-name-0, assignment-state-0, assignment-location-0, assignment-duty-0, assignment-rank-0. Rank dropdown shows 9 entries: '—' (clear) + the 8 ranks (Grand/Master/Senior/Advanced/Junior Sirius + Eagle/Clover/Guardian) with star annotations (e.g. 'Senior Sirius (3★)'). Selecting 'Senior Sirius', filling Duty Title 'Treasurer', and checking Current correctly DISABLES the end-date input. Clicking Save (data-testid='em-save-btn') shows 'Saved' toast. Reopen confirms persistence: row is preloaded with 'Senior Sirius' rank + Treasurer + Current. Reorder buttons (assignment-up-1 / assignment-down-0) verified by observing rank text swap between rows 0 and 1 after a single up-click. Remove (assignment-remove-0) deletes the row; after Save + reopen only 1 row remains.
critical_code_review_comments: _personnel_brief_pdf_response (server.py ~L5004) cleanly renders the 10-section layout via reusable section_table/data_table helpers and a single Paragraph(section) header for each. §10 sort key uses (is_current desc → start_date desc), which matches the 'current first, then most-recent' spec.

_build_tax_letter_pdf (server.py ~L5363) filters transactions with {status:'completed', type:{$in:['renewal','donation','fee']}, created_at:{$gte:Y-01-01,$lt:(Y+1)-01-01}} — pending tx are correctly excluded. Signature image rendered via Image('/app/backend/assets/cory_signature.png', 2.0in x 0.78in) with try/except fallback so the letter still generates if the asset is missing. EIN '82-0794957' is hard-coded in both the header subline AND the body paragraph for redundancy.
Default-year logic for tax letter: `if year is None: year = now_utc().year - 1` — matches spec ('last completed year').

models.RANK_CHOICES is a Literal of 9 string values ('' + 8 ranks). AssignmentEntry stores rank as plain str (not the Literal) — this is intentional so that legacy/blank values do not break Pydantic validation; admin UI enforces the dropdown choices.

AssignmentHistoryEditor.jsx exposes a complete deterministic data-testid set: assignment-history-editor, add-assignment-btn, assignment-row-{i}, assignment-start-{i}, assignment-end-{i}, assignment-current-{i}, assignment-chapter-{i}, assignment-chapter-name-{i}, assignment-state-{i}, assignment-location-{i}, assignment-duty-{i}, assignment-rank-{i}, assignment-up-{i}, assignment-down-{i}, assignment-remove-{i}. is_current correctly disables end-date input.

Profile.jsx DownloadTaxLetterButton (~L649) — block wires the Select to local state, builds a 6-year list (current + 5 prior) and on click uses fetch with credentials:'include' then triggers a Blob download + toast. Good UX. Profile header now hosts both DownloadMyBriefButton and DownloadTaxLetterButton inline.

Minor (LOW, no action): The rank dropdown labels include a star annotation like 'Senior Sirius (3★)' for display. The backend stores plain 'Senior Sirius' (label stripped on save), so backend round-trip + PDF render still get the clean string — confirmed via the assignment_history round-trip test. UI strings are presentational only.

Minor (LOW, no action): The /api/me/tax-letter/pdf returns the same PDF even when the member has zero matching transactions ($0.00 total). That's correct behavior (acknowledgment letter still issues), but the UI could optionally warn if total=0. Not a deliverable for iter30 — flagging as a future enhancement only.
Minor (LOW, carry-over): per-row 'edit-event-{id}' on Admin Events list still missing (noted in iter27/28/29). Unrelated to iter30.
